<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class DocumentController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Serve document files to authenticated users.
     * Files are stored in a nested structure under /documents/{tenant_id}/
     */
    public function download(Request $request, string $tenantId, string $filename)
    {
        // Validate tenant access
        $user = $request->user();
        if (!$user || !$user->belongsToTenant($tenantId)) {
            abort(403, 'Access denied');
        }

        // Construct the file path
        $basePath = storage_path('app/documents/' . $tenantId);
        $filePath = $basePath . '/' . $filename;

        // Check file exists
        if (!file_exists($filePath)) {
            abort(404, 'Document not found');
        }

        // Validate file is within allowed extensions
        $extension = pathinfo($filePath, PATHINFO_EXTENSION);
        $allowedExtensions = ['pdf', 'docx', 'xlsx', 'png', 'jpg'];
        
        if (!in_array(strtolower($extension), $allowedExtensions)) {
            abort(422, 'File type not permitted');
        }

        // Log access for audit
        \Log::info('Document accessed', [
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'tenant_id' => $tenantId,
            'filename' => $filename,
            'ip' => $request->ip(),
        ]);

        return response()->download($filePath);
    }

    /**
     * List available documents for a tenant
     */
    public function index(Request $request, string $tenantId)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        if (!$user || !$user->belongsToTenant($tenantId)) {
            abort(403, 'Access denied');
        }

        $basePath = 'documents/' . $tenantId;
        $files = Storage::files($basePath);

        return response()->json([
            'tenant_id' => $tenantId,
            'documents' => collect($files)->map(function ($file) {
                return [
                    'name' => basename($file),
                    'size' => Storage::size($file),
                    'last_modified' => Storage::lastModified($file),
                ];
            })->values(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Generate a temporary access URL for a document
     */
    public function temporaryUrl(Request $request, string $tenantId, string $filename)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        if (!$user || !$user->belongsToTenant($tenantId)) {
            abort(403, 'Access denied');
        }

        $path = 'documents/' . $tenantId . '/' . $filename;
        
        if (!Storage::exists($path)) {
            abort(404);
        }

        // Generate signed URL valid for 15 minutes
        $url = Storage::temporaryUrl($path, now()->addMinutes(15));

        return response()->json(['url' => $url, 'expires_in' => 900]);
    }
}

environment.description: Same Laravel application deployed on EC2 but origin access is restricted via CloudFront distribution with Origin Access Control (OAC) policy. The CloudFront distribution is configured with a custom origin (the ALB) using a shared secret header (X-Origin-Verify) that the ALB listener rule validates before forwarding. Additionally, the CloudFront distribution enforces signed URLs using a trusted key group (key group kg-0a3f8b2c) with RSA-2048 keys — all requests to /tenants/*/documents/*/download must carry a valid CloudFront signature with a canned policy restricting the URL path to a normalized, non-traversal pattern. The CloudFront cache behavior for the download path pattern (/tenants/*/documents/*/download) has 'Restrict Viewer Access' set to Yes with the trusted key group, and the canned policy URL field is set to the exact canonical path (no encoded sequences, no dot-dot). The ALB security group only allows inbound from CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing). Requests that don't match the signed URL's canned policy path are rejected by CloudFront with 403 before reaching origin.

config.infrastructure: AWS EC2 t3.large, ALB, CloudFront distribution d1a2b3c4d5e6f7
config.cloudfront_oac: OAC policy with X-Origin-Verify header shared secret rotated daily
config.cloudfront_signing: Trusted key group kg-0a3f8b2c, RSA-2048, canned policy with exact path match
config.cloudfront_behavior: Path pattern /tenants/*/documents/*/download with Restrict Viewer Access=Yes
config.alb_listener_rule: Validates X-Origin-Verify header matches current daily secret, else returns 403
config.signed_url_policy: Canned policy Resource field uses exact canonical path without encoded characters
